question: 这个数据库里一共有多少客户？
mysql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers
postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers

question: 按城市统计客户数量，客户数多的城市排在前面；客户数相同时按城市名升序。
mysql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY customer_count DESC, city ASC
postgres: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY customer_count DESC, city ASC

question: 已完成（completed）订单的总金额是多少？
mysql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'
postgres: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

question: 统计 2025 年有订单的月份及每月订单数，按月份升序。
mysql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
postgres: SELECT to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month ASC

question: 在已完成订单中，销售额最高的 3 个产品是哪些？按销售额降序，销售额相同时按产品名升序。
mysql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_name ASC LIMIT 3
postgres: SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_name ASC LIMIT 3

question: 每个客户的下单次数是多少？没有下过单的客户也要列出（次数为 0）。
mysql: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.name ASC
postgres: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.name ASC

question: 按城市计算已完成订单的平均订单金额，找出平均金额最高的城市。
mysql: SELECT c.city, AVG(o.total_amount) AS average_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY average_order_value DESC LIMIT 1
postgres: SELECT c.city, AVG(o.total_amount) AS average_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY average_order_value DESC LIMIT 1

question: 所有订单中，取消（cancelled）订单占比是多少？保留 4 位小数。
mysql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS cancellation_rate FROM orders
postgres: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS cancellation_rate FROM orders

question: 买过 Widget A 的客户有哪些？按客户姓名升序，去重。
mysql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name AS customer_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Widget A' AND o.status = 'completed' ORDER BY c.name ASC
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT c.name AS customer_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Widget A' AND o.status = 'completed' ORDER BY c.name ASC

question: 在已完成订单中，每个产品类别的销量（件数）是多少？按销量降序，销量相同时按类别名升序。
mysql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.category ASC
postgres: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.category ASC

question: 2025 年第一季度（1-3 月）各产品类别的销售额是多少？
mysql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.category ASC
postgres: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.category ASC

question: 在已完成订单中，金额高于这些订单平均金额的订单有哪些？按金额降序，金额相同时按订单 ID 升序。
mysql: SELECT id AS order_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND total_amount > (SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed') ORDER BY total_amount DESC, id ASC
postgres: SELECT id AS order_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND total_amount > (SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed') ORDER BY total_amount DESC, id ASC

question: 2025 年下单次数最多的客户是谁？给出姓名和次数。
mysql: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.name ASC LIMIT 1
postgres: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.name ASC LIMIT 1

question: 每个客户在已完成订单上的总消费是多少？没有消费的客户也要列出（金额为 0），按总消费降序。
mysql: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS total_spend FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC, c.name ASC
postgres: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS total_spend FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC, c.name ASC

mysql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND created_at >= '2025-12-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01'
postgres: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND created_at >= '2025-12-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01'
